relations.myth: Flora reveals her former Greek identity
relations.note: Flora says she was formerly the Greek nymph Chloris.
Zephyrus seizes Chloris by force and subsequently marries her.

relations.myth: Zephyrus grants Flora dominion over flowers
relations.note: Zephyrus gives Flora a flower-filled garden and sovereignty over blossoms.
Flora applies a magical flower to Juno, enabling conception without Jupiter.

relations.myth: Conception of Mars by a magical flower
relations.note: Mars is conceived through Flora's magical flower and reproductive contrivance.

relations.myth: Secret conception of Mars without Jupiter
relations.note: Flora secretly helps Juno reproduce without Jupiter and fears his anger.
Minerva's motherless birth prompts Juno to seek Flora's reproductive aid.

relations.myth: Hyacinthus becomes a flower from blood
relations.note: Flora claims to make a flower from Hyacinthus's blood.

relations.myth: Narcissus persists as a garden flower
relations.note: Flora includes the dead Narcissus among youths preserved as flowers.
Flora claims Crocus among wounded youths rendered beautiful as flowers.
Flora includes Attis among wounded or dead youths preserved through flowers.
Flora includes Adonis among figures whose wounds become beautiful flowers.
Flora appears as Cerial Flora within the cereal-centered cult of Ceres.
Antiquarian lists contrast Flora's flowering protection with protection against cereal rust.
